acceptance_gates.canary: mega_cruise_5000_e_baseline 20 paired seeds read out before any further submit
acceptance_gates.dry_run: scripts/campaign describe/submit dry-run counts equal this design (60 blocks, arrayProperties.size=20 each)
acceptance_gates.field_prestage: 32 fields solved locally, every solve <= 30 s, uploaded with SHA256 recorded
acceptance_gates.geometry_seed_gate: all source zones exist; seed mapping deterministic; paired seeds use identical source realization across lanes and arms
acceptance_gates.local_smoke: campaign worker writes the declared artifact; each arm's op reaches the engine (edits log and realized settings differ from baseline exactly as declared); output contract unchanged
acceptance_gates.phase1_bridge: expedition_cruise_450 baseline N/E/P cells reproduce Phase 1 cell_{seed}.json metrics seed-for-seed

arm_application: tools.contam_fleet_compare._apply_arm_ops on a copy of the platform air_flow_paths.json; edits log and realized per-group settings recorded in every cell

ach_150_supply.description: High-turnover arm: ach x1.5 restricted to supply groups (PR #1187 scope); duty-0 exhausts unchanged.

baseline.description: Shipped airflow and engine parameters; anchor for every contrast; the only P-lane arm.

eq_gain_025_filter.description: Equal-gain partner of oa_050: filter 0.6875 at OA 0.2 gives r = 0.25 on every supply group.

filter_090.description: Filter efficiency 0.5 -> 0.9 (fleet arm filter_merv13 figure); engine-level on both lanes.

oa_050.description: Outdoor-air fraction 0.5 on the supply groups; duty-0 exhaust branches keep declared OA 1.0.

oa_050_filter_090.description: Combined OA 0.5 and filter 0.9; the strongest fixed-field removal arm of the DC01 ordering.

oa_080.description: Matched-removal partner of ach_150_supply: OA 0.8 at baseline turnover gives r_low = 0.1 on every supply group.

baseline_sha.note: manifest §11.7: decisive_contrasts.csv baseline_sha re-pinned to origin/main at design freeze

DC01.prediction: B_V(OF) <= B_V(F) <= B_V(O) <= B_V(B) per seed per lane; per-zone E_i(12h) ordering
DC01.readout: ordering pass counts and violation lists; control, not a result

DC02.readout: paired O - G on B_V and max_i |E_i(O) - E_i(G)|; exact zero in N means gain-only operator

DC04.r_low_rule: r_low = 1 - alpha * (1 - r_base), must lie in [0, 1] on every supply group; the arm fails closed otherwise
DC04.readout: paired A - R, A - B, R - B on B_V; reductions R_a = 1 - B_a/B_B with pairwise gap; per-zone dE_i distribution and sign-flip zones

DC05.readout: paired N - E per arm; arm-effect parity between lanes; realized vs declared per-AHS flows from the E field

DC07.readout: per hull x lane x arm x source class: receptor E_i(12h)/emitted mass, local vs remote, p50/p95/max, time-to-peak, first arrival, never-reached count

contamx.license_notice: NIST Contam is U.S. public domain (17 U.S.C. §105); the official NIST tarball is redistributable with notice.

field_cache_prestage.key_rule: <hull>:<lane>:<arm>; every field records the ops, edits, realized per-group ach/hvac_duty/oa_fraction and the filter efficiency used at export
field_cache_prestage.phase1_byte_comparison: report-only reproducibility control; never a selector

lanes.E: fresh commissioned ContamX export of the arm-mutated JSON + AHS synthesis
lanes.N: native heuristic HVAC + passive/cross-zone flows from the arm-mutated air_flow_paths.json
lanes.P: committed contam/platform.prj + path_map.json, baseline arm only

matrix.p_contrast: 4 hulls x P x baseline x 20 paired seeds
matrix.primary: 4 hulls x N/E x 7 arms x 20 paired seeds x 12 epochs x 1h

seed_mapping.pairing: seed s selects the same source realization in every lane and every arm of a hull
seed_mapping.rule: k=seed-1; timing=k mod 2; pool_index=(k//2) mod pool_length

threshold_basis.extrapolation_rule: predicted full panel = total_trajectories x pilot mean per-trajectory CPU (or bytes); bound is 12 x the measured Phase 1 full panel
threshold_basis.frozen: thresholds are never adjusted after a measurement

timing_patterns.t0_t1_split: 500000 at t=0h and 500000 after first hourly step
